title: Cryptographic Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) Review & Digest Binding Standard

pages.content: Control HITL-DIGEST-801 specifies when a RAG response cannot be released directly to end users and must enter the transactional SQLite review queue with status pending_review. Automatic queueing occurs whenever: (a) any retrieved passage is flagged as stale beyond max_staleness_days, (b) the passage claim support rate falls below 0.72, or (c) the query touches regulated compliance boundaries.

pages.section_heading: 2. SHA-256 Evidence Digest Binding & Upstream Invalidation
pages.content: Human reviewer sign-off (approve or reject) is cryptographically bound to the composite evidence digest: SHA256(normalized_query || sorted_chunk_sha256_digests || answer_sha256). Before serving any previously approved response, the runtime recomputes the digest against current corpus chunk hashes. Any upstream document edit changes the chunk SHA-256 and automatically transitions the record status to invalidated_by_upstream_edit.
